traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Argophyllaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or serrate; veins pinnate; blades linear, oblong, obovate, ovate, lanceolate or oblanceolate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary half inferior or inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary, in racemes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit capsule or drupe; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5 to 8; carpels 2 to 6. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
